title: Pin maps and their folders
description: Pin maps are named sets of map pins on one slot ("Holy sites", "Battles"); a pin joins one by naming its id in properties.pinMap. An embed shows one with ?pins=<id>, and a region can include some (properties.pinMaps) so their pins show on its embed. Folders sort the pin maps in the admin page's Pins tab and nest like the Regions tab's folders: a folder lists the ids of its pin maps in `regions`, and a pin map is in at most one folder. Edited from the admin page; the public embed only reads the names (bundled into pins/<slot>.json).

parent.description: The id of the folder this one sits in. Absent at the top level.

regions.description: Ids of the pin maps in this folder (named `regions` so the folder code is shared with the Regions tab).

legends.description: Per slot (by slot id): the words the embed's pin legend uses instead of the defaults. Only labels change: a kind keeps its icon, colour and its id in ?pins=.

kinds.description: A label per pin kind id; kinds not listed keep their default label.

id.description: Permanent id (a slug made from the name when it was created); what ?pins= uses.

name.description: What it is called; can be renamed.

slot.description: The slot whose map its pins are on.
